questions.q_en: A dishonest seller sells rice at a profit of 23% on cost price and wheat at a profit of 20% on cost price. He also uses a measure of 750 gm instead of 1 Kg. Find the percent profit earned by him, if he sells 1 Kg rice and 1 Kg wheat to a customer.
questions.solution_en:
Let, cost price of 1 Kg rice = Rs.100

And cost price of 1 Kg wheat = Rs.100

Total cost price of 1 Kg rice and 1 Kg wheat = Rs.200

Selling price of 750 gm rice = 100 x 123/100 = Rs.123

Selling price of 1 Kg = 1000 gm rice = 123/750 x 1000 = Rs.164

Selling price of 750 gm wheat = 100 x 120/100 = Rs.120

Selling price of 1 Kg = 1000 gm wheat = 120/750 x 1000 = Rs.160

Total selling price of 1 Kg rice and 1 Kg wheat = 164 + 160 = Rs.324

% profit = (324 - 200)/200 x 100

= 124/200 x 100

= 62%

questions.q_en: A vessel is filled with liquid, 12 parts of which are water and 13 parts are syrup. How much of the mixture must be drawn off and replaced with water so that the mixture may be half water and half syrup?
questions.solution_en:
Let the vessel contains 25 litres of liquid.

Let x litres of the liquid be replaced with water.

Quantity of water in new mixture = [12 - (12x/25) + x] litres

Quantity of syrup in new mixture = [13 - 13x/25] litres

[12 - (12x/25) + x] = [13 - 13x/25]

300 - 12x + 25x = 325 - 13x

26x = 25

x = 25/26

So, part of mixture replaced = (25/26) / 25 = 1/26

questions.q_en: A train running at the speed of 54 km/h crosses a platform in 45 seconds. If the platform is renovated and its length is double, then the same train crosses the platform in 65 seconds. Find the length of the train.
questions.solution_en:
Speed of the train = 54 * 5/18 = 15 m/sec [To convert km/h into m/sec multiply by 5/18]

Distance = Speed * Time

Let the length of the train and platform be x m and y m respectively.

x + y = 45 * 15 ... (i)

x + 2y = 65 * 15 ... (ii)

From (i) and (ii)

x = 375 m

questions.q_en: A sum of money doubles itself in 4 years at simple interest. In how much time will it become 7 times at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution_en:
Let sum = P and rate of interest = R%

According to the question:

(P * R * 4)/100 = 2P - P

R = 25%

Now,

(P * 25 * t)/100 = 7P - P

t = 24 years

questions.q_en: In a circular path of 600 m, Pankaj and Rohit start walking in opposite directions from the same point at the speeds of 2.85 m/s and 5.4 km/h, respectively. After how many minutes will they meet for the first time? (Rounded off to one decimal point)
questions.solution_en:
The speed of Pankaj = 2.85 m/s

The speed of Rohit = 5.4 km/h = 1.5 m/s

Let the distances covered by Pankaj and Rohit are 'd' m and (600 - d) m respectively.

Since, Pankaj and Rohit would have been covered the respective distances in same time.

So,

d/2.85 = (600 - d)/1.5

1.5d = 1710 - 2.85d

d = 1710/4.35

Now, the time, in which they will meet for the first time = 1710/(4.35 X 2.85)

= 138 seconds

= 2.3 minutes (approx.)

questions.q_en: A sector of a circular sheet of radius 35 cm and an arc length of 132 cm is cut and a cone is formed by joining the edges. What is the volume of the cone formed?
questions.solution_en:
Let h and r be the height and the base radius of the cone formed.

2πr = length of arc = 132 cm

r = (132* 7)/44 = 21 cm

As the slant height of the cone is the radius of the sheet, l = 35 cm

Height of the cone (h)

= √((l)2- (r)2) = √((35)2 - (21)2)

= √(1225-441) = √784 = 28 cm

Therefore volume of the cone formed

= 1/3 * π * (21)2* 28 = 12936 cu cm

questions.q_en: There is a cuboid with surface area of adjacent faces being A cm2, B cm2 and C cm2. Find volume of the cuboid (in cm3).
questions.solution_en:
Let l, b and h be dimensions of cuboid.

Surface area of three faces of cuboid;

l*b = A ..(1)

b*h = B ..(2)

h*l = C ..(3)

Multiplying (1), (2) and (3); we get

(l*b*h)2 = A*B*C

Volume of cuboid = l*b*h = √(ABC)

questions.q_en: A person invested Rs. 8000 in two schemes, some amount at a 12% rate of interest and the remaining amount at an 8% rate of interest for two years. If the simple interest received from both schemes is Rs. 1520, then find the amount invested at a 12% rate of interest.
questions.solution_en:
Let the amount invested at a 12% rate of interest be Rs. 'X'.

S.I = P * R * T/100

1520 = X * 12 * 2/100 + (8000 - X) * 8 * 2/100

152000 = 24X + 128000 - 16X

8X = 24000

X = 3000

Hence, the required value is Rs. 3000.
